transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I keep hearing voices. It's as clear as if somebody is standing right there in my little studio apartment with me. They say my name, and they keep telling me that my work is being judged. And... it happens even when the house is completely quiet and I know for a fact nobody else is there.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?

Well, yes. It kind of goes back and forth. Sometimes I feel... just so bright and chosen, you know? Like I have all these big plans and Greenville just can't even hold them all. But then... I don't know, I'll go right from that to snapping hard at someone over a tiny little thing. Like if one of my home care clients just asks me to repeat myself, I just snap at them.
When you feel especially bright and full of big plans, do you need much less sleep than usual?

Yes, I do. I've gone... well, many nights where I sleep maybe two or three hours at most. And I don't wake up tired at all. I get up feeling completely charged, like I had a full night of rest. I'll just get right out of bed and go straight back to painting or making calls.
Have there been times when you were hearing the voices even though your mood felt normal—not especially high, energized, or irritable?

Yeah, actually. Um... there was a time after my energy finally dropped back down, and I was sleeping more normally again. My mood wasn't high or irritable at all. But the voices... they just kept going for several weeks. And that feeling I had, the belief that people were tracking and judging my work, that didn't go away either. It just stayed with me even when my mood felt completely regular.
Have you also had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
No, I haven't really had that. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes, but I haven't felt depressed like that, no. Not for weeks at a time.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was so high or irritable that other people thought you were acting unlike yourself or out of control?

Yes, people definitely notice. It's like... I'll go from feeling so bright and chosen, like Greenville just can’t hold all the big plans I have, to suddenly being angry. I end up snapping hard at someone over a really small thing. Like at work, if one of my clients just asks me to repeat myself, I'll snap right at them. So yeah, people have definitely told me I'm acting out of control when I get like that.
Have you used drugs like methamphetamine, cocaine, cannabis, LSD, or similar substances around the times when the voices were happening?
No, I don't use any of those. I've never really been into drugs, so it definitely wasn't from anything like that.
Have you had any recent medical illness or head injury?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick, and I definitely haven't hit my head or anything. My health has been pretty normal, physically anyway.
About how long did the voices continue after your mood had returned to normal?

Well, there was a time... after my energy finally dropped back down, and I was actually sleeping through the night again. I thought things were settling, but... the voices didn't stop. They kept going for, I'd say, several weeks. And I still had that strong feeling that people were tracking me, judging everything I did at work. Even though my mood was back to normal, all of that just... stuck around for a while.
Was there ever a time when the voices were happening for at least two weeks while your mood was completely normal?

Yes, like I was just saying, it was definitely for at least two weeks. After my energy finally dropped and I was sleeping normally again, the voices just kept right on going. And that whole belief I had about people tracking my work and judging me... that lasted for several weeks, even though my mood was completely fine during that time.
Have you ever been hospitalized because of one of these high or irritable periods?
No, I haven't. I've never been in the hospital for those times when my energy gets really high or I get irritable. I just... well, I haven't ever had to go to a hospital for it.
